request.prompt:
Create one clean, high-fidelity desktop UI design screenshot for LYStar Code Web, Chinese settings page listing AI agents. Design approval image, not a marketing page. Canvas 1440x1000, flat frontal screenshot, pure white background, no device frame, no annotation, no watermark, no captions outside the interface. Extremely sharp, legible Simplified Chinese and Latin text. Restrained neutral shadcn developer application: system sans for Chinese, monospace for model IDs, text #111111, secondary #767676, hairline #eeeeee, input border #d7d7d7, soft neutral surface #f5f5f5, black #242424 primary button with white text, radius 8, thin Lucide outline icons.

Left settings sidebar exactly 224 wide with vertical divider. Sidebar content: back link "返回工作台", search field "搜索设置"; group "个人" with "外观", "全局提示词"; group "工作区" with "模型与认证", "技能", "智能体" (selected, pale gray rounded row), "迁移导入", "诊断"; group "系统" with "系统", "安全与访问"; group "其他" with "关于". No brand logo in sidebar.

Main content starts at x=264, ends x=1400, width 1136, top padding 32.

Header row, height 32: left title "智能体" at 24px semibold. Right side, 8px gaps: outlined button "协作昵称" 32px tall, 13px text; square 32x32 outline icon button with a thin refresh arrow; black filled button with plus icon and "新建智能体", 32px tall, 13px text. No oversized typography anywhere.

16px below header, filter row height 36, vertically centered: left search input 320x36 with 16px magnifier icon and placeholder "搜索名称或描述"; right side a compact pill tab group, not a bordered button group: three tabs at 13px with small 10px count badges, tab one "全部 7" active with pale gray rounded pill highlight, then "个人 7" and "项目 0" inactive in muted gray, no outer border box, no vertical dividers.

8px below, selection row height 28: left 16px checkbox, label "全选" at 12px, muted count "7 个智能体" at 12px; right aligned small outlined button "批量设置" at 12px, 28px tall, currently disabled pale gray.

12px below, sticky table header height 36 with #f5f5f5 background and only a single 1px bottom line, 12px muted column labels aligned to cell content: leftmost narrow checkbox column with header blank, then "名称与职责", "范围", "模型", "工作区", "工具", right-aligned "操作".

Seven flat table rows below, each exactly 72px tall, separated only by a single 1px #eeeeee bottom line, no cards, no extra padding between rows, no alternating fills, all unselected. Each row: 16px checkbox vertically centered; agent name 14px medium weight #111111 with a small 16px muted outline terminal icon before it; beneath the name one single-line truncated description at 12px #767676; then columns at 12px: scope "个人"; model column with monospace 12px single line "upstream/gpt-6-luna" never wrapped, plus a second line in muted gray 12px "思考 xhigh"; workspace "直接工作"; tool count in muted gray "禁用 2 个"; right-aligned action area with a 12px ghost text button "编辑" at 28px height and a 28x28 three-dot icon button, 4px gap.
